mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_journey_execution_probe (tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, namespace_name, campaign_id, probe_id, activation_sequence, probe_json, deployment_fingerprint, expires_at, created_by, created_at) VALUES (#{key.tenantId}, #{key.environment}, #{key.cell}, #{key.namespace}, #{key.campaignId}, #{key.probeId}, #{value.activationSequence}, #{value.probeJson}, #{value.deploymentFingerprint}, #{value.expiresAt}, #{value.createdBy}, #{value.createdAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE probe_id = mk_journey_execution_probe.probe_id
mapper.select: SELECT activation_sequence AS activationSequence, probe_json AS probeJson, deployment_fingerprint AS deploymentFingerprint, expires_at AS expiresAt, created_by AS createdBy, created_at AS createdAt FROM mk_journey_execution_probe WHERE tenant_id = #{key.tenantId} AND environment_name = #{key.environment} AND cell_id = #{key.cell} AND namespace_name = #{key.namespace} AND campaign_id = #{key.campaignId} AND probe_id = #{key.probeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mk_journey_execution_probe_ack (tenant_id, environment_name, cell_id, namespace_name, campaign_id, probe_id, subtask_index, ack_json, accepted_at) VALUES (#{key.tenantId}, #{key.environment}, #{key.cell}, #{key.namespace}, #{key.campaignId}, #{key.probeId}, #{value.subtaskIndex}, #{value.ackJson}, #{value.acceptedAt})
